jobs.name: gpu-info
jobs.command: nvidia-smi | tee gpu-info.txt && nvcc --version | tee -a gpu-info.txt

jobs.name: build
jobs.command: set -o pipefail; DSHA=$(find experimental/duck_cuda -type f -not -path '*/build-remote/*' -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1); PRE=/opt/duck/prebuilt/$DSHA; if ls "$PRE"/libduck_cuda*.so >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "prebuilt cache HIT $DSHA (skipping nvcc)" | tee build.log && mkdir -p experimental/duck_cuda/build-remote && cp -f "$PRE"/libduck_cuda*.so experimental/duck_cuda/build-remote/; else echo "prebuilt cache MISS $DSHA (rebuilding; expected after source changes)" | tee build.log; (cd experimental/duck_cuda && ./build_remote.sh) 2>&1 | tee -a build.log; fi

jobs.name: train
jobs.command: set -o pipefail; PY=$(command -v python3); $PY -c 'import numpy' 2>/dev/null || $PY -m pip install --quiet numpy; $PY -B -m walk.train.gpu_train --envs 4096 --horizon 64 --updates 99999 --seed 917 --device cuda --library $(find experimental/duck_cuda -name 'libduck_cuda_fast.so' | head -1) --lane-env --policy ff --randomization '{"r_mass":0.1,"r_friction":0.2,"r_kp":0.1,"r_damping":0.2,"max_latency_steps":1}' --resume runs/warmstart.pt --out gpu-train-out --lr 1.5e-4 --max-wall-s 2400 2>&1 | tee gpu-train.log
